The learned  a d v o c a t e f u r t h e r p o i n t e d o u t S e c t i o n 3 ( 1 ) , C l a u s e  P o f t h e a f o r e s a i d A c t a n d s u b m i t t e d t h a t t h e l a b o r a t o r y , w h i c h  h a s g i v e n t h e r e p o r t d a t e d 1 2 . 1 2 . 2 0 1 1 , i s n o t F o o d L a b o r a t o r y w i t h i n t h e
meaning of Section 3(1)(p) of the said Act.

2. In view of the submission canvassed on behalf of the learned  a d v o c a t e f o r t h e p e t i t i o n e r , R U L E . L e a r n e d A P P M s . H B P u n a n i w a i v e s  n o t i c e o f R u l e o n b e h a l f o f r e s p o n d e n t S t a t e o f G u j a r a t .
A d i n t e r i m r e l i e f  in terms of para 9(c).
Liberty to apply for final hearing if the pleadings are over.
